messages:
lucy: Hey @support — AcmeAnalytics hit a 400/500 cascade when calling a tool via the Go SDK. Minimal repro attached. Looks like map[int]string is being marshaled as a JSON object with string keys and our runtime rejects it against the tool schema.

alex: Which SDK version and customer? paste repro + error pls.

lucy: customer: AcmeAnalytics (org-xxxx). Go SDK v0.9.3. Repro: 
```
// Go client snippet
args := map[int]string{1: "foo", 2: "bar"}
resp, err := client.CallTool(ctx, "lookup_items", args)
```
Server log (request body captured):
```
400 schema_validation_failed: field "item_ids" expected array of {key:int,value:string}, got object
payload: {"1":"foo","2":"bar"}
```

lucy: Customer pipeline retries on 400s, which caused a burst of requests and unexpected billing. They're pretty upset.

mike-eng: Historically runtime accepted object maps for many schemas, but for integer-keyed maps we normalize to an array of KV pairs (protobuf compat). Go's json.Marshal emits object with string keys. That mismatch is triggering our validator.

olivia-ml: Confirming impact is on function/tool call path only? If tool selection uses schema matching, malformed args could also affect tool routing.

lucy: So far only tool calls reported. Generate/chat endpoints unaffected.

alex: Short term: server-side compatibility shim to accept object with numeric-string keys and convert to kv array. Long term: patch Go SDK to marshal map[intX] as []KeyValue. Which owner?

mike-eng: I can prototype a lightweight shim in eng-runtime to avoid breaking customer flows. But prefer SDK fix as permanent solution. Shim should be fast — do a digit-only key check and cheap conversion.

sam-go: I'll own the Go SDK change. Plan: at marshal time detect int-keyed maps via reflection and emit []{key:int,value:...} JSON. Add unit + integration tests exercising our schema validator. Will target v0.9.4.

lucy: Repro steps for eng on wire capture: 1) run snippet with v0.9.3 2) capture request body from agent logs 3) see object keys 4) confirm schema_validation_failed in server logs.

alex: Action items: mike-eng -> runtime shim prototype (quick rollback plan) by EOD tomorrow; sam-go -> Go SDK fix + tests for v0.9.4; support (lucy) -> notify customer and offer interim mitigation/bill credit if retries caused costs. olivia-ml -> add to regression watchlist for evals.

mike-eng: Note: ensure shim does not allocate heavily on hot path. I'll implement a simple path: if value is JSON object && all keys match ^\\d+$ && schema expects numeric keys -> convert to kv slice.

lucy: Customer accepted temporary workaround and timeline. They asked for a small repro script to validate post-fix. Sam, can you provide?

sam-go: Will post a tiny test program and CI entry. Also adding an integration test against runtime schema validator.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: eng-runtime/shim v0.1 -> staging @ 2026-03-18T03:00:00Z

alex: Thx everyone. Please drop PR links and customer note drafts here. Closing loop after staging verification.
